tha-ap158:1.1: Kadambapupphiya.] Himavantass' avidūre Kukkuṭo nāma pabbato / tamhi pabbatapādamhi satta Buddhā vasantike. // //
tha-ap158:2.1: Kadambaṃ pupphitaṃ disvā dīparājaṃ va uggataṃ / ubho hatthehi paggayha satta Buddhe samokiriṃ. // //
tha-ap158:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nabhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap158:4.1: Dvenavute ito kappe sattāhuṃ Phullanāyakā / sattaratanasampannā cakkavattī mahabbalā // //
tha-ap158:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Kadambapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Kadambapupphiyattherassa
